lines.text: What a semester, what a ride,
BDI four seventy-five, side by side!
EH-kee five ninety three, we learned and laughed,
这学期一起学习，笑声满满在心底，
lines.roman: zhè xuéqī yìqǐ xuéxí, xiàoshēng mǎnmǎn zài xīndǐ
lines.en: This semester we studied together, hearts full of laughter

lines.text: 课堂点点滴滴，都是珍贵回忆！
lines.roman: kètáng diǎndiǎn dīdī, dōu shì zhēnguì huíyì
lines.en: Every little moment in class is a precious memory!

lines.text: 함께 공부하며 웃던 날들, 기쁨이 가득했죠,
lines.roman: hamkke gongbuhamyeo utdeon naldeul, gippeumi gadeukhaetjyo
lines.en: The days we studied and laughed together were full of joy

lines.text: 가는 길마다 행운이 가득하길, 모두 힘내요!
lines.roman: ganeun gilmada haenguni gadeukhagil, modu himnaeyo
lines.en: May every road you take be full of luck. Keep going, everyone!

lines.text: Cùng học, cùng cười, bao chuyện thật vui,
lines.en: Learning together, laughing together, so many happy moments

lines.text: Chúc bạn đường xa may mắn, mãi vui!
lines.en: Wishing you luck on the long road, and joy always!

lines.text: ¡Qué buen semestre, qué gran amistad!
lines.en: What a great semester, what a great friendship!

lines.text: ¡Suerte en lo que viene, con felicidad!
lines.en: Good luck in what comes next, with happiness!

lines.text: Bonne chance à tous, et bon chemin !
lines.en: Good luck to all, and safe travels!

lines.text: Бірге оқып, бірге күлдік, күндер қандай тамаша,
lines.roman: birge oqyp, birge küldık, künder qandai tamaşa
lines.en: We studied together, laughed together, what wonderful days

lines.text: Алдағы сапарларың сәтті болсын, достар, әрқашан!
lines.roman: aldağy saparlaryñ sättı bolsyn, dostar, ärqaşan
lines.en: May your journeys ahead always go well, friends!

lines.text: सीखा, हँसे, साथ बिताए दिन,
lines.en: We learned, we laughed, we spent our days together

lines.text: आगे की राह में मिलें खुशियाँ हर दिन!
lines.roman: aage ki raah mein milen khushiyaan har din
lines.en: May you find joy every day on the road ahead!

lines.text: درسنا وضحكنا، يا أحلى صحاب،
lines.roman: darasna w ḍiḥikna, ya aḥla ṣḥāb
lines.en: We studied and laughed, my dearest friends

lines.text: الله يوفقكم في كل الدروب!
lines.en: May God grant you success on every path!

lines.text: Belajar bersama, kenangan indah,
lines.en: Learning together, beautiful memories

lines.text: Semoga berjaya, terus melangkah!
lines.en: Wishing you success, keep moving forward!

lines.text: Can lah, we made it—good luck, everyone!
lines.en: Yes we can, we made it! Good luck, everyone!

lines.text: قرينا وضحكنا، صحاب ديما،
lines.en: We studied and laughed, friends forever

lines.text: ربي يسهّل طريقكم، بالفرحة والهناء!
lines.en: May God ease your path, with joy and peace!

lines.text: Wishing you good luck wherever your journey goes!
So long, my friends—we'll meet again!
